owner_policy_lock.rule: Do not block prediction simulation on odds or other non-essential inputs. Odds are not required for prediction generation or candidate-ticket generation unless an exact frozen model mathematically requires them.
owner_policy_lock.simulation_behavior: Proceed with the minimum trustworthy PRE-only race inputs required by the frozen model/selector. Use ablation to demote non-material inputs to optional.
owner_policy_lock.odds_behavior: When odds are absent, still generate prediction/ticket candidates and output the minimum acceptable purchase odds threshold. At real operation time the Owner can compare live odds against that threshold.
owner_policy_lock.formal_science_boundary: Actual odds remain necessary only for claims about realized profitability/ROI and must be genuine pre-close observations when used for that purpose. Their absence must not halt unrelated prediction research.
owner_policy_lock.handoff_requirement: Every future KEIRIN handoff/resume must preserve this separation explicitly; never regress to waiting for odds before simulation.

final_hardening_rules: Outcome-control exceptions are identified by true tuple path components rather than dotted path strings, preventing dotted-key path spoofing.
Only the exact legitimate paths pre_freeze_receipt/winner_prediction and pre_freeze_receipt/post_result_reconstruction are exempted by name; nested or misplaced outcome/result fields remain rejected.
Nonnumeric ticket probabilities fail closed as invalid_ticket_probability.
Invalid winner identity numeric conversion fails closed as winner_prediction_identity_invalid.
Missing or nonnumeric generated competition-gate value fails closed as generated_competition_gate_invalid.
covered_fail_closed_cases: nonpositive, above-one, or nonnumeric ticket probability

external_ci_observation.interpretation: External one-second failure is not treated as code-test evidence because the exact Buildkite log was not accessible. Do not claim a code root cause without exact evidence.

unchanged_bindings.competition_gate: Use the pinned PRE-only internal race-level competition score producer; caller-supplied race competition_score remains forbidden.
unchanged_bindings.contamination_rule: No result, payout, future-data, or post-cutoff reconstruction may enter PRE prediction.

next_execution_order: Fresh-read the branch before repository writes.
Re-check 2026-09-12 Matsuyama and Sasebo final PRE racecard publication using trustworthy public sources without opening target result/payout evidence.
Continue minimum-input PRE-only prospective discovery without waiting for odds.
When a trustworthy final car-number plus rider card is available, freeze the exact PRE bytes/hash and race identity before prediction.
Run the repaired and hardened PRE-only candidate/required-odds path and emit ticket candidate plus raw break-even odds threshold without requiring live odds.
Capture genuine pre-close odds separately when available only for execution-price checks and later formal profitability/ROI evidence.
Do not open result/payout evidence before the separately governed outcome-evaluation gate.
Keep formal scientific verification percentage unchanged unless genuine scientific evidence increases.
